verdicts.evidence: The logbook only transcribes the CMAM aggregation equations (Eq. 4-9) in numpy; it does not implement multi-view evidence extraction from EEG/EOG or demonstrate the integrated ConfSleepNet system for sleep staging.

Explicitly marked BLOCKED: no upstream model code (repo is README-only) and SleepEDF data still downloading; no experiments were run on the hybrid 5-class/3-class category structures or evidence-mapping layer.
Explicitly marked BLOCKED: no ConfSleepNet training runs were executed on any dataset; no accuracy numbers were produced to compare against the claimed 87.2%/85.3%/88.9%/88.2%.
No ablation experiments were run on MASS-SS3; the logbook states the full pipeline is blocked by absent code and pending data, so neither the 88.9%/84.2 nor the 87.4%/82.5 figures were tested.

The logbook transcribed Eq. 4-9 and analytically checked the C→0 and C→1 limits: Proposition 1 holds under both formulations, and Proposition 2 holds under the paper's normalization constraint (u = 1 - Σb); a concrete finding is that the printed Eq. 8 fails Prop. 2 at C→1 (limit gives u_a·u_b/(u_a+u_b) < u_o), suggesting a typo, but the propositions themselves are confirmed.

overall: The logbook provides a concrete analytic verification of Propositions 1-2 (Claim 5), confirming they hold under the paper's normalization while identifying a likely typo in the printed Equation 8. All four empirical/architectural claims (1-4) are inconclusive because no model code existed and no training runs were executed.
